triggerReasons.message: A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Bug, regression, security/auth/session, benchmark, or explicit behavior-change work should have red evidence.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: The plan names the B-43de/B-5082 failure mode, makes Red/Repro tests milestone M1, defines parent-child completion rules, and lists all implementation milestones needed before a full roadmap completion claim is allowed.
acceptanceBindings.note: Binds the plan acceptance claim to red/repro-first, architecture, milestone plan, B-5082 controls, and final verification markers.

diagnosticGaps.message: Intent collision is triggered but no pass decision with acceptedInterpretation is present.

Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured.
